argv: command -v gh || echo absent; command -v git
checks.summary: Measured, and this is why absolute-path resolution is required rather than merely tidy: inside devbox run --pure, `command -v gh` finds nothing (printed 'gh NOT on pure PATH') while `command -v git` resolves to /home/takushi/repos/agentic-loop-foundation-worktrees/v2-task-064/.devbox/nix/profile/default/bin/git. On the host, gh is at /usr/bin/gh, version 'gh version 2.92.0 (2026-04-28)'. A bare exec.Command by name would therefore work on the host and fail in the validated environment -- the same failure V2-017 d6 hit with the claude CLI.

checks.name: a14a-absolute-path-resolution
checks.summary: The adapter resolves through the existing resolveTool helper in internal/runner/confinement.go: the caller's PATH first, then /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin. Asserted with a planted executable on a temporary PATH that resolveTool returns that PATH entry, and that with PATH emptied the fallback is either an absolute path or the bare name -- and that a bare name that resolves nowhere is refused with ErrForgeExecutableMissing rather than silently executed. ResolveExecutable also refuses any relative path outright.

checks.name: a14b-basename-assertion-before-any-process-starts
checks.summary: filepath.Base(resolved) must equal "gh" or the call is refused with ErrForgeExecutableMismatch before anything is started, mirroring V2-017 d6. Asserted for /usr/bin/not-gh, /usr/bin/ghost, /tmp/gh.sh and /usr/bin/git. The refusal is asserted to happen BEFORE the existence check, so a substituted binary is rejected whether or not it exists. runForgeProcess re-checks absoluteness and the basename itself, so no caller can reach a process by hand-building an argv: an empty argv, a bare-name argv and a wrong-basename argv are each refused.

checks.name: a14c-guarded-base-environment-only-granted-names-empty
checks.summary: The child receives the guarded base environment and nothing else, built with the package's existing buildEnvironmentFromBaseNames and checked with the package's existing GuardEnvironment. The measured base name set is exactly {HOME, PATH}: HOME is what lets the CLI find its own configuration store without this code naming that path, and internal/runner's own source guard (TestNoCredentialStorePathReferencedInRunnerNonTestFiles) proves from the AST that no non-test file in the package references a path under the user's home directory. granted_names is the empty array by construction -- ForgeClient.GrantSet is nil on the default client, and ResolveExecutable, ReadArgv and ChildEnvironment each refuse a non-empty grant set with ErrForgeGrantSetNotEmpty. The Secret Broker is never consulted, so credential isolation is proven as an ABSENCE, following V2-017 d8: it was verified empirically that `env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=/usr/bin:/bin gh api --method GET repos/{owner}/{name}` succeeds, so the CLI genuinely takes no credential from argv or environment. Also asserted: a secret-shaped name in the declared base set is refused by the guard, and a declared name that is unset in this process is a hard failure rather than a silently empty value.

checks.name: a14d-four-distinct-refusals-each-with-a-test
checks.summary: Four distinct sentinel errors, each with its own test: ErrForgeGrantSetNotEmpty (TestForgeRefusesANonEmptyGrantSet), ErrForgeExecutableMissing (TestForgeRefusesAMissingExecutable, covering absent file, directory and relative path), ErrForgeExecutableMismatch (TestForgeRefusesABasenameMismatch), and ErrForgeCoordinateInvalid (TestForgeRefusesACoordinateThatIsNotOneSegment, covering empty, /, backslash, . , .., a leading dash and the characters space tab ? # & % @ :). None of these tests starts the gh CLI: the filesystem stat is injected, so every refusal path is exercised from values alone.

checks.name: a14e-no-raw-output-ever-leaves-the-adapter
checks.summary: The adapter returns only the parsed bounded fields (exists, default branch, viewer push permission, forge node id, adapter version, owner, name). The child's standard error is not captured at all -- cmd.Stderr is nil -- so there is no path by which a forge error body could reach a caller, a log or a record, and the process error is replaced by ErrForgeUnreachable naming only the coordinate the caller already had. Standard output is read through a hard 1 MiB cap. Asserted with sentinel values: a response carrying a description and a clone_url yields an observation containing neither; eight unparseable shapes (nil, empty, non-JSON, truncated, missing node id, missing default branch, a mismatched full_name, and a GitHub error body) each return ErrForgeResponseUnreadable, and every returned error message is asserted to contain none of the sentinels. A viewer without push permission is reported as such rather than omitted.

checks.name: read-only-argv
checks.summary: The complete argv is pinned: [<resolved absolute path> api --method GET repos/{owner}/{name}]. The method is stated explicitly rather than relied on as a default, so the argv itself is the evidence that the call is a read. Asserted per argument that no argument equals POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, --field, -f, -F, --input, --header or -H, and asserted over the joined argv that it contains none of token, Authorization, auth or login. The argv also passes the package's existing GuardCommand secret check. The only other argv this adapter can produce is [<resolved> --version].

The check also asserts a negative live answer is real: reading wakuwaku3/this-repository-does-not-exist-v2-064 is required to fail rather than to return reachable-with-empty-fields. No credential value, prompt or raw response was logged. Nothing was created, modified or deleted on the forge: no branch, ref, tag, PR, issue or repository. No auth setup subcommand was run and no git configuration was touched at any scope. Before writing this adapter the coordinator's measurement was independently reconfirmed: `gh auth status` reports logged in to github.com as wakuwaku3 with scopes gist, project, read:org, repo, workflow.

checks.name: a16-no-github-write-and-no-probe-branch
checks.summary: No GitHub write of any kind was performed and no probe branch was created anywhere: the only refs this task touched are its own commits on the existing branch v2-task/V2-064. This matters because docs/architecture/validation.md L187 records that `gitleaks git` scans every ref in the repository, so a left-behind probe branch would keep the secret gate red. Recorded for the successor stage-3 task, measured but deliberately not acted on: `git config --get-all credential.helper` returns nothing at repository scope, at --global scope and at --system scope (exit 1 in all three cases), so a bare `git push` over HTTPS on this machine could not authenticate; origin is the https remote https://github.com/wakuwaku3/agentic-loop-foundation.git; and `gh auth git-credential` exists in gh 2.92.0 and reports 'Implements git credential helper protocol'. `gh auth setup-git` was NOT run and no git configuration was mutated at any scope.
